bio: Hannah Marie Pingree (born October 18, 1976) is an American politician who is the governor-elect of Maine. She served as the 99th speaker of the Maine House of Representatives from 2008 to 2010. A member of the Democratic Party, she was the second woman to hold the position in Maine history.
offices: Speaker of the Maine House of Representatives (2008–2010)
Member of the Maine House of Representatives (2002–2010)
